metadata.notes: Added 2026-08-14 as the concrete proof, not just an assertion, that action.ts's requiredToolCapabilities actually generalizes BOIL/SIMMER/PASTEURIZE beyond the one hardcoded 'pot' id — a saucepan is a real, physically distinct vessel from pot.json (taller-sided, single long handle, typically smaller capacity) that a real kitchen genuinely treats as interchangeable with a pot for boiling/simmering/water-bath work, unlike pan.json's shallow frying pan (see that entity's noIsDeepVesselNote). See scripts/boil-with-any-deep-vessel.ts for BOIL actually executing against this entity, not just this file declaring the capability.
